entry.title: Help the table get ready
entry.summary: Invite your child to bring a manageable item to the table with you. Setting or clearing can be a small shared part of the meal.
entry.cue: Notice interest in carrying things to the table or putting them back after a meal.
detail: Davies keeps a small set of table things in a reachable place and uses a basket to carry them. A picture showing where the plate, glass, and cutlery belong is an optional guide.

Show slow carrying with two hands for a glass or tray, and help as needed. The child might carry one thing while you do the rest. This is a chance to contribute, not a requirement to set a whole table.

ageContext.readiness: Interest in carrying a manageable item, with the adult doing the rest.
ageContext.note: The earlier chart supports helping return a plate after a meal. The fuller table-setting example is listed from 18 months. Age and readiness sources: The Montessori Toddler, PDF pp. 14, 51–52.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
